aggregate.summary: V2 lost two correct answers overall. The cross-system stop guard was directionally useful but its fallback was unstable: among six changed cross-system items it produced two wins, one loss and three both-wrong changes. Several other losses were not evidence against the written guards; they occurred when V2 failed to enforce the Skill's own low-identifiability, whole-chain and weak-signal limits.
